Overview

Čačak is a city in Moravica with a population of 73,000. A city in central Serbia at the foot of Mount Jelica, known for its thermal springs, medieval monasteries, and the Ovčar-Kablar Gorge. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
